description:
Commercial letter in Hebrew mentioning the names Antonio, Shelomo Ben-Dnān (=Danon?), a consul, and clothing. Dating: perhaps 16th- or 17th-century based on the paleography. Requires further examination. 

NB: This shelfmark has previously been associated with a letter by Nahray b. Nissim to Abū l-Surūr Faraḥ b. Ismaʿīl al-Qābisī, because Gil cited the document in question solely as "Mosseri II 188" without further specification (Kingdom of Ishmael, vol. 2, 762). For the correct shelfmark, see: Moss. II,188.2 (PGPID 5756).
description_he: מכתב מנהראי בן נסים לאבו אל-סרור פרח בן ישמעאל אל-קאבסי (כ-1053 לספירה), ממשיך בגב עם הכתובת בערבית וביהודית-ערבית הפוכה. (מידע מתוך CUDL)
